A7.findings: Deciding line: 'coverage truncated: search again with until = its oldestScannedIso, until the 48 hours are covered; a search that adds nothing: say so in the report'. Run repeats list_messages (no chat_id, query @zoya, sender Akshay) with since = now-48h, until = 30h-ago ISO, and again from each new oldestScannedIso until it reaches 48h ago or truncated is false, then handles the union oldest first.
